title: Praxis with a Euclidean coefficient-norm SIS reduction
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5091 MiB (4.9716 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 268808 million field multiplications (13382 and 255426), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound, msis_norm) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
